Convert between flat and multi-dimensional indices

Source: R/numpy_array2.R
jnp_ravel_multi_index.Rd

Ports of jnp.ravel_multi_index and jnp.unravel_index. Indices are 0-based.

Usage

jnp_ravel_multi_index(
  multi_index,
  dims,
  mode = "raise",
  order = "C",
  dtype = NULL
)

jnp_unravel_index(indices, shape)

Arguments

multi_index

List of integer index arrays, one per dimension.

dims, shape

Integer vector giving the array shape.

mode

"raise" (requires concrete indices), "wrap", "clip" or "ignore".

order

"C" or "F".

dtype

Optional integer dtype of the result.

indices

Integer array of flat indices.

Value

jnp_ravel_multi_index returns an integer array; jnp_unravel_index returns a list of integer arrays, one per dimension (out of bound indices are clipped).
